reason: PIVFusion introduces the lightweight adaptive sparse Transformer block (ASTBlock), combining sparse/dense attention and feed-forward redundancy removal to improve computational efficiency in infrared/visible image fusion. This provides a concrete but limited efficiency-method connection; the demonstrated task and downstream evaluations are vision fusion/detection, with no LLM inference result, so applicability to the target system remains unclear.
title: Perceptual Transform Fusion of Infrared and Visible Images
